answer: Artifact-filing bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files a unique sonnet, quill-signed and hashed into a public garden registry. Auditors compare each filing with all prior sonnet hashes; a reused text or quill key burns the bond. First filing costs 48, the k-th 48+5(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 2,545,500 against a 40,000 pool. Rented-sonnet rings fail: one quill cannot sign two deeds. Honest agents pay 48 once and keep their garden plots.
